newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dresdner Kleinwort cuts Philips to Hold.
newsitem.headline: Dresdner Kleinwort cuts Philips to Hold.

text.p: Philips NV Electronics 160.70 Dresdner Kleinwort Benson

COMMENT: (HOLD, from BUY) Stock reached our price target of NLG 155.00. The Dutch market (AEX 951) currently trades on 19.7 and 17.5 times 1997 and 1998 earnings respectively. In the past, Philips has traded at a discount to the market of between 30 and 60 percent to reflect the competitiveness of the market it operates in.

For Philips outperformance to continue, management needs to announce a fresh round of portfolio pruning or release significantly better Q2 results than we are expecting, neither ofwhich, we believe, is very likely.
Our Q2 forecast net income of 523 million guilders is realistic, but towards the top end of expectations.
Philips is still a sprawling conglomerate, operating in fiercely competitive markets.

Most estimates now reflect management's official medium term earnings yield target of 24 percent RONA (return on net assets) and consequently we believe scope for earnings upgrades now much more limited than in October 1996.
